subject.title: Cron session accumulation can silently exhaust agent context window — no guardrails or warnings

question: Should this broad cron session accumulation issue remain the umbrella while the open retention and cadence guardrail PRs are decided, or should maintainers split it into narrower canonical items now?
rationale: Current main still has a real retention bug, but the requested warning thresholds, context-pressure alerts, and schedule-limit behavior are product/config policy choices with active, conflicting slice PRs.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Keep this issue open until the active retention and cadence PRs are landed, replaced, or explicitly rejected, then close or split leftover warning work.

options.title: Split To Narrow Canonicals
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89666 the retention canonical item and use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89739 or a successor for cadence policy.

options.title: Close After Slice Decisions
options.body: Close this issue only after maintainers record decisions for retention cleanup, cadence limits, and any remaining context-warning behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the active retention and cadence PRs are landed, replaced, or explicitly rejected, then close or split leftover warning work.
